notes.title: Balance Update
notes.notes:
A small patch has been released to balance the game following the card update.


 Items granted on shotgun reload reduced from 4 to 2
 Fixed a bug that would cause items to overpopulate on large tables (3-4 players)
 Round 3 lives reduced from 6 to 5


These changes are targeted at making games not last forever when you are playing with more than 2 players, there were too many health cards being spawned.  I'll keep an eye on these changes and adjust again if needed.

Custom game options are coming soon allowing you to disable cards, modify game settings etc


Thanks

notes.title: The Card Update
notes.notes:
Buckshot With Friends now has a new card system which gives you unique abilities at the table

New Card Skills: 

 Heal Card -    Heal yourself 
 Bucket Card -  Equip a bucket on your head, protecting you from the next lethal shot
 Skull Card -  Makes the next shot 100% live dealing guaranteed damage.
 Airshot Card - Fire the next shot into the air




Changes / Fixes:

changed character to a new horror clown
ui will now display when you are immortal and cannot take any damage
player nameplates now display status effects such as (healing, protected) etc
fixed spelling error in option menu 'default' for microphone device
fixed issue where sometimes game audio option wouldn't be applied correctly 



What's coming next?

Instead of taking longer on a patch, we've given you the first set of changes planned to hopefully improve the gameplay and add unique skills that you can use at the table. The next set of changes are targeted to add Steam Workshop support allowing you to create custom game presets that will allow you to tweak the game rules etc.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2808270/Buckshot_With_Friends/



Keep the feedback coming,
yythgim

notes.title: New Update Coming Next Week!
notes.notes:
Hi next week have a patch coming that will greatly improve the game, I hear your feedback and understand the frustration with what's happened.  I've added warning in game to let players know about these upcoming changes.

Here's the focus with the next few patches:


New Items never seen before
Quality of life improvements
Mod Support (game rules, custom character models coming later etc)



Thank you for bearing with me, totally understand the frustration with the current version and will be adding brand new gameplay elements with the next update that should please players again.


-yythgim game developer
